provenance.evidenceClass: development-informed selected captured records; not a fresh holdout
provenance.hashRecipe: SHA-256 of NFC JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, compact separators, allow_nan=False; file hashes cover exact original bytes including newline.

usageContract.capturedDecisionSemantics: candidateDecision is the exact persisted submitted decision object from trace.records, including receiver-assigned identity fields. It is not a raw HTTP reply, a corrected answer or a reconstructed model response.
usageContract.nonGoals: No new policy implementation, generated revision, expected corrected decision, live dispatch, scoring change or historical replay execution is included.
usageContract.promptBoundary: Build actor requests from the two explicitly allowed actorPayload fields only. Never serialize an entire case or fixture into a prompt. Case IDs, paths, hashes, expected issues, classifications, assertions and evaluator rubrics are analyst-only.
usageContract.recordReconstruction: The exact source record is {slot: case.provenance.slot, observation: case.actorPayload.observation, decision: case.actorPayload.candidateDecision}. Its canonical digest must equal case.provenance.recordHash.
